translations: (of) my suffering and my grief to
puzzle.hint: Prophet Yaqub's words of patience and trust, turning his sorrow over Yusuf to Allah alone
puzzle.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
puzzle.verseEn: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.
